{{Quote|The gatekeeper of this teaching device is of a race of beings that evolved from the trees on the planet Myrkr.|Thon, to Nomi Sunrider, speaking about Ood Bnar|<ref name="TotJ5" />}}
The [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]]<ref name="TEGAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref> [[Neti/Legends|Neti]] [[Species/Legends|species]] evolved from '''trees''' found<ref name="TotJ5" /> on the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Myrkr/Legends|Myrkr]]. In [[3999 BBY]], [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi trainee]] [[Nomi Sunrider]] learned from the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Thon]] that the species of a Neti Master [[Ood Bnar]]&mdash;the [[Gatekeeper/Legends|gatekeeper]] of an ancient [[Arca Jeth's holocron|holocron]] which had been lent to Thon by Master [[Arca Jeth]]&mdash;had evolved from these [[Tree/Legends|trees]].<ref name="TotJ5" />
